subject: chemical_engineering

resources.title: NIST Chemistry Standard Reference Data
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.storage_policy: metadata_link_provenance; preserve database-specific terms and access controls
resources.notes: NIST chemistry reference-data portal includes thermochemical, thermophysical, transport-property, kinetics, and Chemistry WebBook resources useful for rigorous chemical-engineering calculations.

resources.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook, SRD 69
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.storage_policy: metadata_link_provenance; do not mirror subscription datasets
resources.notes: Provides evaluated physical and chemical property data for well-defined chemical species and reactions; some linked NIST/TRC products require subscription.

resources.title: Green Engineering Textbook and Training Modules
resources.storage_policy: metadata_link_provenance; verify rights at item level before local full-text ingestion
resources.notes: EPA describes this as senior-to-graduate-level chemical-engineering curriculum material focused on pollution prevention, risk, process/product environmental performance, raw-material use, energy use, wastes, and emissions.

resources.title: Risk Management Program (RMP) Rule Resources
resources.notes: Authoritative chemical-accident-prevention and risk-management reference for facilities using extremely hazardous substances.

resources.title: EPA Existing Chemical Safety Evaluation
resources.notes: Authoritative risk-evaluation and risk-management framework for chemicals under TSCA; useful for safety, exposure, and lifecycle constraints in process design.

resources.title: Hydrogen Production: Electrolysis
resources.notes: DOE technical overview of electrolyzers and electrochemical water splitting. Mapping is limited to levels appropriate for the engineering concepts presented and does not substitute for a full electrochemical-engineering curriculum.

resources.title: Fuel Cells
resources.notes: DOE reference on fuel-cell operation, electrochemical conversion, efficiency and technology classes; useful as an applied electrochemical-engineering source.

resources.title: EPA Wastewater Technology and Treatment Resources
resources.notes: EPA technical and regulatory resources for municipal wastewater treatment include biological treatment and process-system material. This is an applied biochemical-engineering reference, not a complete biochemical-engineering textbook.
